jamie: FYI waking up to a pattern — Xid 13/31 counts spiking on rack r12 between 03:00-04:30 UTC last 3 nights. Not steady high; short bursts tied to small-batch low-latency requests.
sofia: noted. any specific models or tenants?
jamie: mostly embedder and short-context chat routes. tenant ids: t-42, t-77 show 60% of recent hits.
liam: can you paste a sample log?
jamie: ```
[2025-11-03T04:12:05Z] GPU0 Xid 13 pid=9234 model=embedder-v2 seq_len=16 batch_size=1 tenant=t-42
mem_status=ECC_CORRECTABLE count=1
stack: runtime/infer.c:432 runtime/kernel.c:210
```
anika: that stack looks like a decode path hit during tiny batches. we've seen Xid13 for transient memory faults on A10s when the KV cache churn is high.
marcus: rack r12 is all A10s with nominal temp. No ECC panic logs otherwise?
jamie: infra-bot pulled ECC counters: ECC_CORR increases by ~0.4/min during the windows, then decays. No ECC_UNCOR or thermal OOM.
infra-bot: metric snapshot: r12 GPU0-7 ecc_correctable_delta=[0,1,2,0,5,3,1,0] over 15min window.
sofia: interesting — correlated with traffic shape not absolute qps. small batches at high qps.
liam: could be memory read amplification on small-token requests. Would show as higher DRAM activation counts. Can we pull dram_activity metrics?
jamie: pulled: dram_reads per-second for GPU4 jumped 3x during spikes.
anika: action idea: enable higher KV cache hit thresholds for embedder routes on r12 to reduce repeated loads. Also run memtest on suspect GPUs during low traffic.
marcus: is this a candidate for soft-drain + reprovisioning of two cards?
sofia: prefer reproducibility first. schedule a targeted repro test: replay tenant t-42 workload on spare rack copy and watch Xid/ ECC. If repro, plan drain/replace.
oncall: proposed test window: 2025-11-04 02:00 UTC (2h). Who owns?
liam: I can own the replay harness. Need the trace and a spare node in eu-west3.
jamie: trace link: https://ci.internal/traces/repay/2025-11-03-t42 (permissioned).
anika: I'll queue memtest and stress scripts; will also bump ECC scrub frequency on r12 as a soft mitigation.
marcus: cost note — if we drain 2 cards for replacement, we lose ~6% capacity in europe for a week. informs capacity planning.
sofia: add a routing policy to avoid pinning embedder to r12 during test windows (auto-fallback to r8/r9).
liam: test plan: 1) replay 6h of t-42 traffic at realtime qps 2) monitor Xid/ECC/dram_reads/latency 3) if Xid rate > threshold -> mark GPUs for replacement.
jamie: threshold suggestion: >5 Xid13 events per GPU per hour and ECC_CORR delta > 50 in stress window.
anika: I'll run memtest overnight on GPU5 and GPU6 (highest deltas).
oncall: noted. I'll update oncall runbook to escalate to HW swap when threshold met.
marcus: also check NVLINK logs; last time we saw packet errors preceding Xid13.
jamie: pulling nvlink counters now, will dump to /tmp/xid-r12-nvlink.log and share.
sofia: long term: engineer idea — telemetry tag for small-batch, low-seq workloads so we can route them away from known weak cards automatically. Add to backlog?
liam: +1. I'll open a short spec RFC after test.
anika: interim ops: soft-drain GPUs if repro confirmed, then schedule physical replacement during maintenance window (non-peak).
marcus: ack. make sure we include capacity impact in the ticket.
jamie: thanks team. I'll post test results in this thread after the run. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: test job scheduled: replay-2850012345-run1, ETA start 2025-11-04T02:00Z. Logs to: https://ci.internal/jobs/2850012345
sofia: perfect. if repro fails, we escalate to vendor support with full traces.
liam: copying the plan to the capacity runbook and adding a note about cost-impact estimate.
jamie: closing interim — will follow up with pass/fail and next steps.
